summary: Iteration 2 backend testing of SHG BANK new features: guarantor system, member self-savings, admin edit/delete on savings/contributions/loans, and interest auto-distribution. Wrote 31 new pytest tests in test_shg_v2_features.py covering all 19 review-request scenarios. After fixing one missing-field bug in apply_loan, ALL 31 tests pass (100%).

minor.issue: Original bug: guarantorId & guarantorName were validated but NEVER persisted on the Loan document - Loan() constructor in apply_loan was missing the two fields. Fixed during testing (see updated_files).

Admin's share_contrib uses average of non_admin contributions; ratio share = (share_contrib/total_contribs)*total_interest. This will mean total distributed != total_interest (since admin gets an extra avg slice on top of 100%). Verify intended business logic with stakeholder.
Uses regex match on description='Interest auto-credit' to detect prior credits — if admin renames an entry via PUT /api/savings/{id} the dedupe will miss it and double-credit.
No validation that 'type' (if updated) is in ['deposit','withdrawal']; also no balance check when changing amount/type — could yield negative balance.
No 404 when loan_id does not exist (silent no-op, returns null body).
Same — no 404 on missing id; also allows status update to any string (no enum validation).
Performs N+1 query (one DB call per member for is_member_blocked_as_guarantor). Fine at 24 members but will not scale.
Does not validate that member_id exists - returns full list even for nonexistent id.

action_items: Verified & shipped: guarantorId/guarantorName now correctly persisted on new loans (fixed in /app/backend/server.py apply_loan).
Consider rejecting type updates outside ['deposit','withdrawal'] on PUT /api/savings/{id} and recomputing balance.
Add 404 on PUT /api/loans/{id} and PUT /api/contributions/{id} when document not found.
Confirm distribute-interest math: admin shouldn't share in their own interest unless intended.
Update obsolete test_shg_backend.py::test_savings_deposit_non_admin_blocked — expected 403 but member self-deposit is now allowed by design (new feature). Old test must be updated or removed.

Carry over from iteration_1: hash passwords, switch to JWT, add 404s on approve/reject, validate memberId in savings deposit/withdraw, balance-check withdraw, mobile uniqueness on member PUT, CSV proper response type.
critical_code_review_comments: BUG (FIXED): apply_loan dropped guarantor fields silently — the entire guarantor feature was non-functional for new loans before fix.
is_member_blocked_as_guarantor uses python sum on (paid_amount/total) — handles total=0 via 'or 1' which masks bad data but is acceptable.
distribute-interest dedupe relies on description string match ('^Interest auto-credit') — fragile to admin edits.
No transactional/atomic safety on distribute-interest: a crash mid-loop leaves partial credits; idempotency saves a re-run though.
Member.password still plaintext (carried over from iteration_1 - security CRITICAL).
Token is still raw memberId UUID (carried over - security CRITICAL).
No 404 handling on PUT /api/loans/{id}, PUT /api/contributions/{id} - silently no-ops and returns null.
server.py is now ~1127 lines - approaching the 700-line guideline; consider splitting into routers (auth, loans, contributions, savings, settings, stats).
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_shg_v2_features.py (new test file with 31 tests for v2 features)

success_rate.backend: 100% on v2 features (31/31). Iteration 1 suite: 39/43 — 4 failures are stale-state from MongoDB persistence between runs, not regressions.

seed_data_creation: Tests created/left in MongoDB: 1 active loan for NISHA (₹20000, 4 months, MEENA guarantor, 3/4 EMIs paid -> 75% complete still active), interest auto-credit savings entries for several members (Interest auto-credit description), and a few TEST_ contribution edits. Old loan tests cleaned up after themselves.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New feature test file: /app/backend/tests/test_shg_v2_features.py uses module-level SHARED dict for cross-test state. The clean_state autouse fixture deletes active loans for NISHA/MEENA/REKHA before tests so guarantor flow is deterministic. apply_loan now correctly persists guarantor fields. distribute-interest idempotency works via description regex match. test_shg_backend.py::test_savings_deposit_non_admin_blocked is now WRONG by spec (self-deposit allowed).
rca of the issue: RCA - guarantorId not stored on loan: In server.py apply_loan() the input.guarantorId was validated (existence, self-check, blocked-check) and guarantor_name was looked up, but when constructing the Loan() Pydantic instance the two fields were never passed. Since Loan model defaults them to None, the loan was created with guarantorId=None. Downstream is_member_blocked_as_guarantor() never found the guarantor, so the entire 'block guarantor until 75% paid' logic was dead. Fix: 2 lines added (guarantorId=input.guarantorId, guarantorName=guarantor_name) to the Loan() ctor. Reproduction: POST /api/loans/apply with amount>15000 and a valid guarantorId — pre-fix the returned loan.guarantorId was null. Post-fix it correctly stores both id and name.
